assessment.question:
### Exercise 15.2: Measure angles

6. Use a protractor and measure the angle shown below.

[Source image: https://electricbookworks.github.io/siyavula-open-textbooks-images/items/images/web/ebw-jss1-15-023.png]
assessment.expected_answer:
Estimate: reflex angle, so between $180^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$.

Measure the angle that is not shaded and then subtract the answer from $360^{\circ}$.

Acute $C\hat{A}B = 49^{\circ}$.

Subtract to find the size of the reflex angle: Reflex $C\hat{A}B = 360^{\circ} - 49^{\circ} = 311^{\circ}$.
